#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <climits>

using namespace std;

int main() {
    int a, b, l, r;
    cin >> a >> b >> l >> r;
    l--; r--; // convert to 0-indexed

    int min_ans = 26;
    for (char p = 'a'; p <= 'z'; ++p) {
        for (char q = 'a' + a; q <= 'z'; ++q) {
            string rep;
            // first a characters: a, b, c, ...
            for (int i = 0; i < a; ++i) rep.push_back('a' + i);
            // next b characters: all p
            for (int i = 0; i < b; ++i) rep.push_back(p);
            // next a characters: each determined by last a+i characters
            for (int i = 0; i < a; ++i) {
                bool f[26] = {false};
                // check characters from index b to a+b+i-1 (length a+i)
                for (int j = b; j < a + b + i; ++j) {
                    f[rep[j] - 'a'] = true;
                }
                // find first missing character
                for (int j = 0; j < 26; ++j) {
                    if (!f[j]) {
                        rep.push_back('a' + j);
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }
            // last b characters: all q
            for (int i = 0; i < b; ++i) rep.push_back(q);

            // count distinct letters in range [l, r] (cyclic)
            bool flag[26] = {false};
            if (r - l + 1 >= 100000) {
                // just check all letters in rep
                for (char c : rep) flag[c - 'a'] = true;
            } else {
                for (int i = l; i <= r; ++i) {
                    flag[rep[i % rep.length()] - 'a'] = true;
                }
            }

            int ans = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < 26; ++i) if (flag[i]) ++ans;
            min_ans = min(min_ans, ans);
        }
    }

    cout << min_ans << endl;
    return 0;
}
